release_notes: 911 Teams Cards is now its own app, so you can post cards without running a setup and run a setup without posting cards - it needs no batch number, and it opens a tick-list of every nest waiting on the EB 922 Schedule so you can card just the ones you want. The schedule's STATUS column now maintains itself: a nest moves off the card queue when its card is posted and off the setup queue once its batch is set up. 911 Setup remembers which steps you last chose to run, between sessions and across updates. Cancelling a run now reports as cancelled instead of playing the success sound and awarding tickets. Difficulty labels are working again - the schedule's rating column had been renamed and TechDeck was still looking for the old name, so packets and cards had quietly stopped showing a rating.
